definitions.explanation: To move on foot at a normal pace. Distinguished from {走|はし}る (hashiru, to run) which is faster movement.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}まで{歩|ある}いて{行|い}きます。
examples.notes: 歩いて = on foot, by walking

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}を{歩|ある}きましょう。
ここから{駅|えき}まで{歩|ある}いて15{分|ふん}かかります。
examples.english: It takes 15 minutes to walk from here to the station.

notes: A godan verb ending in く. Te-form is {歩|ある}いて. Often used with {行|い}く or {来|く}る to indicate mode of transportation: {歩|ある}いて{行|い}く (go on foot).
